picks.title: Iran says deal with Oman on Strait of Hormuz is in final stages
picks.summary: Iran and Oman are reportedly close to finalizing an agreement governing navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, though neither the US nor Oman has confirmed the terms; Al Jazeera separately reports US officials say they won't accept any deal that leaves Iran in control of the waterway.
flags: Terms unconfirmed by US or Oman; competing framings of who controls the strait

picks.title: In Odesa, no-one is safe from Russia's new Black Sea strikes
picks.summary: Russia has intensified strikes on Ukraine's Black Sea coastline, leaving blackened ships and smashed docks in Odesa; Ukrainian marketplace Rozetka separately says it suffered its largest-ever losses from a related strike, and Lithuania warns Russia could use captured Ukrainian drones to stage provocations against the Baltics.

picks.title: 'Morocco feels emboldened': Trump's influence in spotlight after Ceuta disaster
picks.summary: As Spain deals with the aftermath of a sudden influx of over 70,000 people into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta, scrutiny is falling on the close Washington-Rabat relationship — highlighted by Morocco naming a $1bn highway after Trump and joining his 'Board of Peace' initiative.
